desc: Read K, S, T from stdin.
Verify banded DP logic with sample inputs and edge cases (length difference > K, K=0, empty bands).
Double-check offset arithmetic for dp_prev and dp_cur indices to avoid off-by-one errors.
Ensure base cases DP[0][j] and DP[i][0] are set correctly within the band.
Handle edge case where | |S| - |T| | > K → immediate "No".
Add early exit if any DP value in a row exceeds K (optional optimization).
Output "Yes" or "No" based on DP result.
